evidence.name: Screen field: Roundness of the corners
evidence.userNeed: Know what "Roundness of the corners" controls and when to adjust it while editing a screen.

sections.title: Roundness of the corners
sections.description: How rounded the four corners of the picker container are, in pixels (0-50, default 12). 0 gives sharp square corners; higher values look softer and more modern. Match it to the corner roundness of your buttons and other cards so the whole funnel feels consistent.
